name: Gujarat Cotex Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Gujarat Cotex Ltd is in the business of trading textile fabrics and land[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
GCL is in the business of bleaching, weaving, printing, and selling cloths and other like materials, mainly in the domestic market. It als does purchase and sale of non-agri plots of land

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Debtor days have improved from 177 to 106 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 72.3 days to 48.1 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.08% over last 3 years.
